MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

2. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

3. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 6
   C. 36
   D. 18

4. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 21

5. Solve for x: x + 7 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 11

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 26

7. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 3

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

9. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 1

10. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 22
   C. 28
   D. 33

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

14. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

16. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 23

17. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 49

18. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

19. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

20. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 36
   C. 30
   D. 18

22. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 0

23. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 82

24. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
